workstreams.name: Marketplace hypotheses
workstreams.answers: Which hypotheses on the marketplace blueprint and the distributors' role must the design test?
activities: Interview the CEO, Head of Sales and distributors council
Review order data from the existing B2B ordering portal
Draft hypotheses on each blueprint component

workstreams.name: Contractor buying needs
workstreams.answers: How do small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain buy today, and what would make them order online?
activities: Interview contractors in both countries on how they buy
Analyze warehouse order data by customer size
Review marketplaces already serving contractors

workstreams.name: Distributor role and terms
workstreams.answers: Where would the marketplace overlap with regional distributors, and what role keeps them committed?
activities: Interview distributors and the distributors council
Map where contractor demand overlaps distributor sales
Review distributor contracts for affected terms

workstreams.name: Blueprint and pilot plan
workstreams.answers: What marketplace blueprint do the tested hypotheses support, and how would a one-region pilot run?
activities: Draft the blueprint with tested hypotheses
Test a wireframe prototype with contractors
Plan the pilot region, scope and launch steps

workstreams.name: Pilot contractor group
workstreams.answers: Which small and mid-size contractors in the pilot region should be the first group to use the marketplace?
activities: Analyze order data for contractor groups in the region
Interview contractors and distributors in the region
Agree the first contractor group with the Head of Sales

workstreams.name: Pilot KPIs and distributors
workstreams.answers: Which KPIs do the stakeholders agree on, and how do repeat orders and distributor contract status develop?
activities: Agree the KPIs with each stakeholder group
Track repeat orders from contractors in operational data
Track distributor contract status and hear their concerns

workstreams.name: Marketplace first version
workstreams.answers: Can a first marketplace version be built and launched to a small group of contractors in one region?
activities: Build the first marketplace version from the blueprint
Prepare the readiness review for the first workshop
Launch after the workshop and fix issues from live use

workstreams.name: Pilot evidence and scale-up
workstreams.answers: What does scaling beyond the pilot region require, and is the evidence ready for the 2027 budget round?
activities: Synthesize order data and interviews against the criteria
Draft the scale-up business case and roadmap
Prepare the evidence for the final readout
